summary: Amortize FFI overhead with batched token counting

delivery.outcome: Amortize measured FFI overhead with count_ascii_tokens_many and one additive versioned C batch call; validate parity, pointer/length errors, legacy scalar compatibility and >=2x median speedup for 256x64B, then independently publish/merge.
nonGoals: Change scalar token semantics, C ABI version1 baseline, dependency versions or supported platforms.
Claim universal speedup, zero-copy batching or measured nl-* fleet improvement; batch adapter joins buffers once.
Publish a registry release, deploy, migrate consumers, edit protected policy or self-approve/merge.

architecture.decision: Batch ABI accepts one contiguous immutable byte region and size_t lengths, validates sum with checked arithmetic, pointer/count/slice limits before writes, and reuses scalar Rust kernel per segment. Raw output writes allow uninitialized C storage. Python snapshots/normalizes bytes subclasses, joins once and calls Rust once; compiled-Python batch uses the same reference semantics and existing verified loader factored without changing scalar validation. ABI1 scalar entry stays compatible; missing optional batch symbol raises NativeArtifactError. Benchmark compares warmed full public adapters and records copy cost/limits.
interfaceChanges: additive sorust_count_ascii_tokens_many_v1(data, length, lengths, count, output) C entry
private compiled-Python batch implementation supporting reference parity
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent protected review; keep prior dist, exact baseline wheel/venv, benchmark samples and all generated data.

validation.evidence: Differential generator/bytes-subclass/empty/binary/UTF8 inputs, one-call safe lengths, invalid native parameters/overflow with unchanged outputs, verified compiled imports and legacy ABI1 scalar compatibility.

Record warmed median of9 repeats including public adapter overhead/copying; >=2x for256x64B vs same-wheel scalar Rust; report3B/4096B cases, exact manifest/compiler and no-CPU-affinity limits. Full build/export/C/Rust/Python regression suite passes.
Existing indexed canonical documentv10 binds source/tests/benchmark; required exact-head checks and independent approval/merge, then current-owner release and exact preserved worktree cleanup.
